agent.reason: The hard dead-zone family has the lowest pooled leave-one-trajectory-out `y` rollout RMSE among retained candidates: approximately `0.116` in unknown `y` units, compared with `0.122` for the smooth monotone family and `0.216` for the affine-input kinematic reference. All use only training data. The smooth family is competitive and has lower full-training error, so the recommendation is provisional given only three experiments. The threshold candidate also avoids local command-response reversal and prevents negative displacement length at small positive `x3`. Residuals still show unresolved input-change transients.
